item.text: I found the global privilege API maps the group permission `groups:view:users` to `privileges.global.can('view:users', uid)`, with UID `0` representing the Guest role. I’ll use that check explicitly, resolve `acct:<userslug>@<hostname>` through the userslug lookup, and build absolute profile aliases from the configured site URL.

Implemented WebFinger discovery at `/.well-known/webfinger`. The handler validates the resource and hostname, checks `view:users` permission (evaluating anonymous callers as Guest), resolves the user slug, and returns the subject, UID and slug aliases, and an HTML profile link.
